content.text:
git commit -m "fix: Enable mobile app to fetch events directly from Supabase REST API
- Replace hardcoded local backend URL (192.168.68.101:8080) with Supabase direct access
- App now fetches events via Supabase REST API instead of local server
- Fix column name mapping (title_sv/title_en instead of title)
- Normalize event data to match expected app format
- Kulturhuset pipeline: 61 events now accessible from mobile app
Root cause: App was trying to reach non-reachable local backend server from mobile device"
[main 41b7fc4b] fix: Enable mobile app to fetch events directly from Supabase REST API
 5 files changed, 116 insertions(+), 174 deletions(-)
